tickets.name: Ravens +10 -115

legs.label: Ravens +10
legs.why: combined_edge -0.013 (Rule B). Pin fair 54.2% at +10.5; own 54.0%, within 6 points of Pin.

tickets.why: Own 54.0% vs 53.5% breakeven, Pin fair 54.2% (at +10.5, so DK's +10 is half a point worse). Rule B: Fagnano is off the injury report but is a rookie third-string QB, Jags are 74% of tickets, and double digits is a lot for a short-week road team that runs the ball and bleeds clock. Thin edge, small stake. Profit Boost token goes here if Luke holds one.
tickets.kill_switch: Fagnano ruled out at 6:45 PM inactives (Slovis starts): Ravens +10 gets worse, skip it and put the full $10 on Under 39.5 only if that number is still 39.5 or higher, else split $5 each. If already placed, keep unless Fagnano is out, then cash out in app if offered. Do not take Ravens +9.5 or shorter than -125.

tickets.name: Under 39.5 -110

legs.label: Under 39.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.031 (Rule B). Pin fair 49.3%; own 52.8% is within 6 points of Pin and above DK's 52.4%.

tickets.why: Own 52.8% vs 52.4% breakeven. Rule B: rookie QB on a short week, rain in the forecast (CBS, UNVERIFIED), Jaguars lead the league in low fourth-quarter dropbacks so they run clock with a lead. Total already fell from 40.5 to 39.5 and Pin is at fair, so this is a very thin lean. Dog plus under correlation with ticket 1 is across two tickets, not an SGP, so no SGP repricing. Not a $5 SGP because no second leg clears Rule B: Ravens ML (-0.011) is own 20.5% vs 20.8% breakeven.
tickets.kill_switch: Total 38.5 or lower, or heavy wind or rain confirmed already priced: skip and move the $5 to Ravens +10. If already placed, keep. Fagnano out: total drops, Under at 39.5 gets better, keep.

tickets.name: Dolphins ML +295

legs.label: Dolphins ML
legs.why: combined_edge +0.017 (Rule A). Pin fair +270 (27.0%) vs DK +295.

tickets.why: Own 26.5% vs 25.3% breakeven, Pin fair 27.0%. Rule A.
